support.subtitle: What your subscriptions actually cost, and a reminder before each payment

faq.q: How do I add a subscription?
faq.a: Tap the + button, then enter the name, price, frequency, and date of the “Next Payment”. Tacite will then calculate all future payment dates, as well as the monthly and yearly cost. A month-end date is respected: if you sign up on the 31st, the charge will be on the 28th or 29th of February, then again on the 31st of March.

For each subscription, “Remind me” lets you choose: no reminder, same day, one day before, or two, three or seven days before. Set the notification time in Settings › “Reminder time”. If you haven’t enabled notifications, a button in Settings will take you straight to your iPhone’s Settings.
Turn on “Free trial in progress”: the trial ends on the date of the next payment. Tacite will remind you by the day before at the latest, giving you time to cancel if the service isn’t right for you.

faq.q: I’ve been paying for this subscription a long time—how do I count it properly?
faq.a: Turn on “I’ve been paying since…” and enter the date of your first payment. Past payments will then be included in the statistics and total paid amount, without changing future due dates.

faq.q: I share this subscription—how do I only count my part?
faq.a: Turn on “Shared with others” and enter “My share”. Totals and reminders will then use your share, while the subscription details still show the full price.

faq.q: I canceled a subscription: should I delete it?
faq.a: It’s better to mark it as canceled: in its card, tap “I Canceled This Subscription” and choose the date of your final charge. It will no longer appear in totals or reminders, but remains in your history and statistics. You can re-enable it anytime.

faq.q: Can Tacite cancel a subscription on my behalf?
faq.a: No: Tacite isn't connected to any service or your bank. For an App Store subscription, “Manage my App Store subscriptions” opens your Apple account’s subscriptions page directly. For others, cancellation must be done on the service's website.

faq.q: I have subscriptions in multiple currencies.
faq.a: Each subscription keeps its original currency, and totals are shown separately for each without conversion. Choose your preferred currency in Settings › “Primary currency”.

faq.q: How do I add the widget?
faq.a: Press and hold the Home Screen or Lock Screen, then tap “Edit” and “Add Widget”, and select Tacite. The “Upcoming Payments” widget is available in small and medium sizes on the Home Screen, and in two formats on the Lock Screen.

faq.q: Is my data backed up or synced?
faq.a: Your subscriptions are stored on your iPhone and may be included in backups if you’ve enabled them. Tacite doesn’t sync data across devices, and all data is deleted if you uninstall the app. To keep a copy, use Settings › “Export to CSV”.

support.privacy_summary: Tacite collects no personal data, connects to no servers, and contains no ads, in-app purchases, or trackers. Your subscriptions stay on your iPhone.

blocks.p: Tacite does not collect any personal data. The app works offline, connects to no servers, requires no account, and has no access to your bank. Everything you enter stays on your iPhone, unless you choose to export it.

The app stores the subscriptions you enter (name, price, currency, frequency, dates, category, colour, payment method and notes) and your settings. The “Payment method” field is free text: never enter a card number here.

This data is stored on your iPhone, in an area shared only with the Tacite widget, and the developer does not have access to it. Like other app data, it may appear in your iPhone backups if you have enabled them. Deleting the app erases it.

Reminders are local notifications: they are scheduled and displayed by your iPhone itself, without going through any server. They contain the subscription name, amount and payment date. You can disable them at any time in iOS Settings.
Nothing leaves the app without your action. The CSV export contains your subscriptions: you choose where to send or save it, and it is then subject to the terms of the chosen service.
Tacite only requests permission to display notifications, for reminders. No camera, location, contacts, or photos.
Tacite is free. It contains no ads, in-app purchases, trackers, or tools for analytics or usage statistics.
The app doesn’t collect any data and is suitable for all ages.
If this policy changes, the new version will be published on this page with its update date.
